dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric 2D tapering from the widest mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth with no visible asymmetrical bulges or structural indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high-intensity specular highlights and deep blue-toned shadows.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A thin, low-contrast linear mark is visible on the lower left dorsal-lateral plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, longitudinal, shadow-casting indentation or deep fold is visible along the center-left axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a significant longitudinal dorsal crease and a minor linear mark on the posterior left flank.
